verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity call the Vanta API to query controls, remediate failing tests, and act on compliance data. A guide covers connecting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Perplexity, and probes confirm the MCP docs page and an llms.txt that advertises the MCP server. A separate Developer Docs MCP server is also offered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work through the server in practice.
